modifiers: diagonal slash from top-left to bottom-right

ambiguity: Distinguishable from a plain Wi-Fi icon only by the diagonal slash, which remains clear even at small sizes.

reasoning: A universally recognized crossed-out Wi-Fi symbol meaning no wireless connection, offline mode, or disabling Wi-Fi. It fits a focused set of tasks around troubleshooting internet outages, turning off wireless networks, cancelling ISP service, or preparing for offline work/travel, and must be distinguished from a normal active Wi-Fi icon.
